verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap is a speech-to-text API service, and a built-in assistant (for example, a dashboard copilot) is a plausible capability for this kind of product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no built-in AI assistant to which users can delegate tasks. The MCP server and the x402 API let external AI assistants and agents call the product, which is the inverse role and earns no credit for a built-in in-product assistant.
